author: J. G. Keulemans
suggested_alt: Keulemans lithograph of North and South Island tomtits perched on a twig
notes: No PD/CC0 photo of the North Island tomtit (toitoi) exists on Commons; the only PD photo is a South Island (yellow-breasted) bird at 900px. This is Keulemans' plate V from Buller (1888), cropped by me to the top 44% to show both tomtits and leave out the robins below. The North Island tomtit is the black-and-white bird on the right. Saved at 1183px wide (native width).
